# Kafka Connect Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Apache Kafka

## Overview

Implements Kafka Connect for data integration with source and sink connectors, transforms, and connector management

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [kafka-connect-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
kafka-connect-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@kafka-connect-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure source connectors for data ingestion
- Set up sink connectors for data export
- Implement Single Message Transforms
- Manage connectors with REST API

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Kafka Connect**: Connector framework and configuration
- **SMTs**: Single Message Transform patterns
- **Connector Management**: REST API for connector lifecycle
